entries.implementationStatus: not-yet-implemented: the any-repo reader is gap G1 of docs/polaris-generation/TRACKER.md; the only real-input reader today is the Syzygy self-corpus. implementationVersion stays null (Unknown), never a placeholder
entries.contractVersionSource: the value the adopted Butlers observer entry declares for the same contract; re-derive by script before the offering

governingBehaviorContract.version: Unknown: pinned by the offering step to the generation specification bytes in force, base REQ-polaris-generation-017 and 025 plus the understanding and tree-form amendments
governingBehaviorContract.signedBy: pending exact owner act over this entry

subject.observedRepositories: each (project:syzygy, repository) pair that has its own in-force observation consent; the entry names no repository, and a repository not covered by an effective consent is not read

entries.authorizationModeDerivation: every read needs this entry's effective exact owner act, the pair's effective observation consent and the effective public-source screening scope; owner-trusted-bootstrap while those acts are state (1); every other combination rejects before the fetch
entries.provenanceDisclosure: Acquisition is admitted on owner-trusted records; independent audit is not configured.
entries.determinism: the fetch is a capture: a recording of what the hosting service returned for the named commit at the capture instant. Tree listing, blob reads and span derivation from those captured objects are derivation-deterministic over the identified capture

questions: What does this exact commit contain?
typedAuthority.readAuthority: the snapshot objects of each admitted commit only: the commit, its root tree and the trees and blobs reachable from it. Reads go through Git object access in the run-directory repository, never a checked-out working tree; no ancestor commit, issue, pull request, CI log or release asset is requested
typedAuthority.fetch: one shallow fetch of exactly one admitted commit object id per fetch from the upstream locator named in the observation consent (git fetch --depth=1 <upstream> <commit>); a fetch of any other object, ref or history is refused
typedAuthority.runDirectoryWrites: the local repository created for the run inside the run directory under project:syzygy's state directory, outside git, and the acquisition capture records; nothing is written to the observed repository, its forks or its tracker
networkAccess: the upstream Git hosting service named by the pair's observation consent, for the fetch only; no other destination
typedAuthority.submodules: not fetched; a submodule not vendored at the admitted revision is outside the grant

entries.screening: every blob passes the effective public-source screening scope of project:syzygy before ingest (RFC5-16, RFC3-30); an observed repository's own policy files supply no policy; excluded or unclassifiable content yields a hash-not-body exclusion record

resourceLimits.status: [Inferred] proposed values for the owner to confirm or change; none is measured, because no target body has been read

resourceLimitSemantics.maxSources: the complete tree-known source population; an excess preserves every tree-known identity but admits no body beyond the limit and makes dependent claims Unknown, recorded as deferred-by-budget
resourceLimitSemantics.maxBytesPerSource: the exact blob before classification; a larger blob is excluded with a recorded reason, or chunked into spans by the reader, and never fails the run
resourceLimitSemantics.maxTotalBytes: one cumulative counter across the run; each path plus object id body counted once
resourceLimitSemantics.maxFetchBytesPerCommit: the transfer for one shallow fetch; an excess aborts that fetch and the revision is Unknown with source-uncaptured-or-unreachable
resourceLimitSemantics.breachResult: input breaches retain the complete population and make dependent facts Unknown; nothing success-shaped is emitted
